services.title: Clinical Programs & Treatments
services.subtitle: Discover evidence-informed medical services delivered by certified specialists in modern clinical suites.

cardioConsultation.title: Cardiology Consultation & Screening
cardioConsultation.subtitle: Comprehensive heart health evaluations and early risk prevention.
cardioConsultation.description: A thorough cardiovascular screening including 12-lead ECG, blood pressure profiling, cholesterol risk assessment, and personalized cardiac health recommendations.
cardioConsultation.f2: Arterial pressure and vascular stiffness evaluation
cardioConsultation.f3: Cardiac biomarker and lipid profile review
cardioConsultation.f4: Personalized lifestyle and preventive risk report
cardioConsultation.b2: Direct consultation with European Board-Certified cardiologist
cardioConsultation.b3: Actionable dietary and exercise management roadmap
cardioConsultation.suitableFor: Adults experiencing chest tightness, palpitations, family history of heart disease, or routine health checkups.
cardioConsultation.q1: Do I need to fast before this appointment?
cardioConsultation.a1: Yes, for optimal lipid and metabolic blood analysis, an 8 to 10 hour overnight fast with water is recommended.
cardioConsultation.q2: Are ECG results discussed on the same day?
cardioConsultation.a2: Yes, our cardiologist reviews and explains your ECG graphs and primary observations immediately during your visit.

dermatologyCare.title: Clinical & Aesthetic Dermatology
dermatologyCare.subtitle: Specialized dermatological diagnostics and skin health therapies.
dermatologyCare.description: Medical management of chronic skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, acne vulgaris, coupled with high-precision digital dermoscopy for mole assessments.
dermatologyCare.f1: Digital dermoscopy and full-body mole screening
dermatologyCare.f2: Targeted acne and rosacea therapeutic protocols
dermatologyCare.f4: Skin barrier restoration and sun damage assessment
dermatologyCare.b3: Healthy, confident skin with sustainable results
dermatologyCare.suitableFor: Individuals seeking clear diagnoses for recurring skin rashes, acne, pigment changes, or yearly skin checkups.
dermatologyCare.q1: Can I wear cosmetics to my skin consultation?
dermatologyCare.a1: We recommend arriving with clean skin free of heavy makeup so the dermatologist can examine your skin barrier clearly.

pediatricCheckup.title: Pediatric Wellness & Developmental Checkup
pediatricCheckup.subtitle: Nurturing care for infants, children, and teenagers.
pediatricCheckup.description: Comprehensive physical exams, growth and milestone tracking, developmental screening, and parent advisory in a warm, child-friendly environment.
pediatricCheckup.f1: Physical growth percentiles and developmental milestones
pediatricCheckup.f2: Pediatric vision, hearing, and postural screening
pediatricCheckup.f3: Nutritional counseling for growing infants and kids
pediatricCheckup.b2: Thorough reassurance and answers for parent concerns
pediatricCheckup.suitableFor: Children aged 0 to 16 for routine growth assessments or school entry health clearance.
pediatricCheckup.q1: How long does a pediatric wellness visit take?
pediatricCheckup.a1: Typically around 40 minutes, ensuring your child remains calm and comfortable throughout the examination.

dentalCare.title: Preventive & Aesthetic Dental Care
dentalCare.subtitle: Precision oral hygiene, smile aesthetics, and preventive dental care.
dentalCare.description: Gentle ultrasonic scaling, digital intraoral imaging, enamel remineralization, and conservative cosmetic restorations.
dentalCare.f2: Gentle ultrasonic cleaning and plaque removal
dentalCare.b2: Restores natural tooth brightness and gum health
dentalCare.b3: Avoids future complex and costly restorative procedures
dentalCare.suitableFor: Patients due for biannual dental prophylaxis or experiencing tooth sensitivity.
dentalCare.a1: No, our modern ultrasonic tips use micro-vibrations and cooling water for a gentle, virtually painless experience.

orthoCare.title: Orthopedic & Joint Rehabilitation
orthoCare.subtitle: Non-surgical musculoskeletal therapy and joint restoration.
orthoCare.description: Targeted musculoskeletal assessments, joint mobility testing, ergonomic guidance, and customized recovery programs for sports and age-related issues.
orthoCare.f2: Joint range of motion and ligamentous stability tests
orthoCare.f4: Ergonomic workspace and spinal support advisory
orthoCare.b1: Relief from chronic back, neck, and joint discomfort
orthoCare.suitableFor: People with back stiffness, sports strains, knee pain, or posture-related aches.
orthoCare.q1: Do I need an X-ray prior to the orthopedic consultation?
orthoCare.a1: If you already have recent imaging, please bring it along. If not, our specialist can determine if imaging is indicated.

healthScreening.title: Executive Health Screening
healthScreening.subtitle: A multi-system preventative checkup for busy professionals.
healthScreening.description: An all-inclusive wellness screening evaluating metabolic function, renal and liver health, cardiovascular indices, and comprehensive blood panels.
healthScreening.f1: Comprehensive metabolic, liver, and kidney blood panels
healthScreening.f2: Complete blood count and inflammatory markers
healthScreening.f3: Resting ECG and body composition analysis
healthScreening.f4: Detailed multi-page health summary with doctor debrief
healthScreening.b1: Complete peace of mind regarding baseline vitality
healthScreening.b3: Direct consultation with an Internal Medicine Consultant
healthScreening.suitableFor: Adults seeking an annual comprehensive health audit to optimize long-term health and vitality.
healthScreening.q1: How fast are the laboratory results ready?
healthScreening.a1: Most laboratory panels are completed within 2 to 4 hours due to our in-house automated laboratory.
